items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: Wyatt Schultz. Uh-oh. I met him in Jackson, Mississippi. He was a local official over there.

ctx.x: And he acted like pork chops.

Yeah. And there's Dave Winstein. Yeah. And he's playing, what, alto? Yeah, he's playing alto. And Dave is a terrific musician. Never made a mistake, but he sounded like a punky goat. Uh-oh, a saw. I always kid him about it there. And there's Pinky Gerbrecht, you know, that name. Yeah. Elroy Mazur. Wyatt Schultz. Uh-oh. I met him in Jackson, Mississippi. He was a local official over there.
